scenario: Build a twelve-week learner-controlled plan for practical data visualization using my supplied portfolio samples, weekly availability, free-resource constraint, and checkpoint rubric.

messages.text: Build a twelve-week learner-controlled plan for practical data visualization using my supplied portfolio samples, weekly availability, free-resource constraint, and checkpoint rubric.
I identified the requested job, required evidence, and the authority boundary that remains human-owned.
Make the result useful in an ordinary chat client and leave a durable handoff.

I produced and validated outputs/learning-plan.json, then rendered the durable handoff at outputs/learning-plan-coordinator-handoff.md with competencies, prerequisites, evidence, blocked checkpoints, and the learner-owned next revision separated.

report.title: Learning plan coordinator session handoff
report.summary: A versioned competency plan links prerequisites, selected resources, weekly practice, checkpoint criteria, evidence gaps, accessibility constraints, and review decisions without purchasing, enrolling, grading, or claiming mastery.

items.title: Competency and prerequisite map
items.summary: The competency map records current evidence state and explicit prerequisite links without inferring mastery.

items.title: Sequenced practice and resource plan
items.summary: Every planned activity traces to a competency, prerequisite state, selected free resource, owner, time budget, and checkpoint criterion.

items.title: Checkpoint evidence ledger
items.summary: Checkpoint records distinguish supporting evidence, gaps, blocked states, and the learner-owned evidence still required.

items.title: Versioned progress review and next-plan handoff
items.summary: The next revision preserves failed, skipped, and blocked checkpoints while leaving enrollment, purchase, grading, credentialing, and mastery decisions with authorized humans.
